topic.source_contract: hedgerow location and length, protected and important status, removal notice, authority decision, wildlife constraints, replacement, establishment and compliance evidence

scope_guards: A mapped field boundary is not treated as a regulated hedgerow.
A hedgerow removal notice is not treated as permission to remove.
No authority response is not treated as approval before the statutory period expires.
A planning permission is not treated as a hedgerow removal decision.
A replacement notice is not treated as completed replacement.
A management exemption is not treated as permission for removal.
New planting is not treated as established replacement hedgerow.
No score or promotion is written without exact status, notice, decision, timing, works and establishment evidence.
